execute_requires: --execute on the explicitly selected Linux Docker host

optional_case_fields.mysql_force: boolean; true permitted only for report 111559

scope: 5–10 frozen report IDs; initial manifest covers exactly its frozen report × version task IDs. role must be target and requested_version must equal target_version.
initial: batch_kind initial; each frozen pair has exactly one repeat=1

confirmation.scope: subset of the same frozen first batch, same source SQL hashes
confirmation.paths: All evidence paths are relative to the confirmation manifest directory and may not escape it. The initial manifest and records must be preserved copies with verified hashes.
confirmation.condition: Exactly one sql_submitted initial record for each requested pair; at most repeat2 and repeat3 in the confirmation manifest.
confirmation.execution_claim: Creates records_file + .confirmation-claimed.json exclusively. A second invocation against that evidence location is rejected; do not copy evidence elsewhere to bypass this guard.

limits.cleanup_allowance: short independent inspect/log/stop timeouts to ensure owned containers can be stopped after the experiment deadline

environment: frozen local image IDs, no pull
new token-labelled offline containers and new empty data directories
only standard system databases before tests
exact server version and release build evidence
SHOW ENGINES and server/client/session variables recorded
executed_sql: USE unique owned schema; SET time_zone='+00:00'; SELECT __preflight_* variables in the actual session; source SQL in original order. Raw reviewed SQL hash and executed wrapper hash both saved.
sql_errors: All stderr error codes retained even with --force. exit0 plus SQL ERROR is completed_with_sql_errors. SQL errors are not automatically bug/crash results.
stop_conditions: server stopped or failed liveness check
cleanup: Stop only containers whose purpose/token/run labels match. No container restart/recovery and no deletion of any schema, directory, container, image or original materials. Exclusive data directories and logs are retained.
tests: 17 mocked unit tests passed; no Docker, database, server connection or installation performed by the implementation agent.
